name: VSN Mirage III
summary: VSN team's free Mirage III C/S (plus two-seat B/D) for DCS World.
description:
Free VSN mod adding the Dassault Mirage IIIC and IIIS, with two-seat B and D versions in the current build; FC3 SFM. Flyable with the FC3 (F-15C/Su-27-style) cockpit, or as AI without FC3.

VSN's downloads are on pCloud and ask for a password; VSN publishes it on their download index: `VSNROX`.

Requires: Flyable only with Flaming Cliffs 3 installed; otherwise usable as AI.
license: Free, private use only, commercial use prohibited (VSN terms)
